get.description: Own and delegated person access. Invitation-backed, ongoing/upcoming scheduled activities starting within 90 days; includes declined and not-yet-sent invitations. Each activity includes only sent invitations for authorized people, with current responses; future invitations remain hidden. Stable starts_at/id order, 50 activities per page, no duplicates. No-store. Offset 0..100000; concurrent changes may shift pages.

Complete authorized upcoming overview, including dated team memberships, own team access and currently managed teams. Person rows exist independently of invitations. Only sent personal invitations are exposed. No 90-day cutoff or first-page counts. More than 20000 activities fails with 503 rather than returning an incomplete overview. No-store.
